# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_journal_map_scales.py — do not edit manually.
# The Map Room's maps fitted to the world (te_journal_map_scales_generated.txt). Each te_jmap_range_<map>
# measures a map's range into te_jmap_rng_<map>_lo / _hi: it counts the states the map paints with a figure
# (te_jmap_n), works out how many each end leaves out (te_jmap_k), and has te_jmap_measure_at take the state
# at that place from the top and from the bottom (te_jmap_measure_<map>, K a literal: position takes no
# script value). By default the 5th highest and the 5th lowest; never past the middle of a short list; no
# state with a figure, and the globals stay unset (the fixed curve's ends). A range the Map Room reads counts
# only the states in the Map Room's area (te_jmap_in_area) and takes its Outliers option's trim
# (te_jmap_trim_count); a range a system's own entry reads (te_jmap_range_gw, _gm) is the whole world's on the
# default trim, whatever the options, and the Map Room reads its twin (_room). Any scope: every_state and
# ordered_state walk the world's states. te_jmap_refresh_range measures the pick's map (te_jmap_set_selector
# and te_jmap_apply_options, te_journal_map_effects.txt; and monthly, te_journal_map_on_actions.txt),
# te_jmap_refresh_entry_ranges the entries' own.

# Turmoil, the radicals' share: half the color by a fifth of the world's range, the rest more slowly.
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_turmoil = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = turmoil }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_turmoil = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_turmoil_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi value = te_jmap_turmoil_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_turmoil_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo value = te_jmap_turmoil_input }
	}
}

# Global Warming: the state's share of the world's emissions last year (a share, owner 2026-11-06): half the color by a fifth of the world's range; a thousand-odd states average 0.1%.

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_lo

		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gw_hi

	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis te_jmap_gw_world > 0 te_jmap_gw_state_emis >= 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count_entry }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = gw }
}

	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = gw_state_emis te_jmap_gw_world > 0 te_jmap_gw_state_emis >= 0 }

		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_gw_hi value = te_jmap_gw_input }

te_jmap_measure_gm = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gm_monument = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_gm_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_gm_hi value = te_jmap_gm_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gm_monument = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_gm_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_gm_lo value = te_jmap_gm_input }
	}
}

# Grand Monuments: the state's grandeur, two-thirds of the color by a third of the world's range.
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_gm_room = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_room_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_room_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_room_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gm_room_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gm_monument = yes te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = gm_room }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_gm_room = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gm_monument = yes te_jmap_in_area = yes }

		position = $K$

		position = $K$

# Tourism's Base Appeal, the state panel's row, 0-1 (stored monthly by te_update_tourism_modifier); 0.2 is the score of a region the table doesn't list.
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_tourism = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tourism_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tourism_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tourism_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_tourism_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tourism_base_appeal te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = tourism }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_tourism = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tourism_base_appeal te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_tourism_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_tourism_hi value = te_jmap_tourism_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tourism_base_appeal te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_tourism_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_tourism_lo value = te_jmap_tourism_input }
	}
}

# GDP per capita, a year's GDP per person in pounds: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low to its high (a rich country about 1 in 1836, 8 in 1917, 60 today).
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_gdppc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_lo

		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_hi

	every_state = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = gdppc }

	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}

		order_by = te_jmap_fam_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_fam_hi value = te_jmap_fam_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_fam has_variable = te_dg_people te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_fam_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_fam_lo value = te_jmap_fam_input }
	}
}

# Capitalists, their share of the state's people (the yearly walk's): half the color by a fifth of the world's range.
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_capitalists = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_capitalists_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_capitalists_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_capitalists_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_capitalists_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_capitalists has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = capitalists }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_capitalists = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_capitalists has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_capitalists_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_capitalists_hi value = te_jmap_capitalists_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_capitalists has_variable = te_dg_walk_pop var:te_dg_walk_pop > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_capitalists_input_neg
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_capitalists_lo value = te_jmap_capitalists_input }
	}
}

# Trade Capacity, the state's own, its Trade Center's: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low (at least 1) to its high.
# The Map Room's range, under its options.
te_jmap_range_trade = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_trade_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_trade_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_trade_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_trade_hi
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n value = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_trade_capacity > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_n add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_k value = te_jmap_trim_count }
	te_jmap_measure_at = { MAP = trade }
	# What the Map Room's page says the map was measured over.
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_n value = te_jmap_states }
	set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_shown_k value = te_jmap_cut }
}
# Its two ends: the state K places from the top, and from the bottom.
te_jmap_measure_trade = {
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { te_jmap_trade_capacity > 0 te_jmap_in_area = yes }
		order_by = te_jmap_trade_input
		position = $K$
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_trade_hi value = te_jmap_trade_input }

	}

# The pick's map, if it is fitted to the world (te_jmap_selector, te_journal_map_values.txt).
te_jmap_refresh_range = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 1 }
		te_jmap_range_turmoil = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 3 }
		te_jmap_range_e0 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 4 }
		te_jmap_range_tfr = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 5 }
		te_jmap_range_median = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 6 }
		te_jmap_range_devastation = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 7 }
		te_jmap_range_natural = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 8 }
		te_jmap_range_cdr = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 9 }
		te_jmap_range_cbr = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 10 }

	}

	else_if = {

	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
